scope: ordinary public SQL missing-column metadata; not Scala acceptance

cases.name: one_suggestion
cases.sql: SELECT Foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo) a
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `Foo` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`foo`].

cases.name: no_suggestion
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITHOUT_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `missing` cannot be resolved.

cases.name: join_aliases
cases.sql: SELECT z1.Foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo) z1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT 2 AS bar) a_insensitive CROSS JOIN (SELECT 3 AS foo) z2
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `z1`.`Foo` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`z1`.`foo`, `z2`.`foo`, `a_insensitive`.`bar`].

cases.name: two_qualifiers
cases.sql: SELECT ext.Foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo) z_sensitive CROSS JOIN (SELECT 2 AS foo) ext
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `ext`.`Foo` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`ext`.`foo`, `z_sensitive`.`foo`].

cases.name: limit_five
cases.sql: SELECT missing FROM (SELECT 1 AS aaa,2 AS bbb,3 AS ccc,4 AS ddd,5 AS eee,6 AS fff,7 AS ggg) q
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `missing` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`aaa`, `bbb`, `ccc`, `ddd`, `eee`].

cases.name: dotted_name
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `A.B` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`a.b`].

cases.name: escaped_backtick
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `A``B` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`a``b`].

cases.name: unicode_distance
cases.sql: SELECT `😀` FROM (SELECT 1 AS `😁`,2 AS a,3 AS `雪`) q
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `😀` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`😁`, `a`, `雪`].

cases.name: qualified_missing
cases.sql: SELECT q.Foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo,2 AS bar) q
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `q`.`Foo` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`q`.`foo`, `q`.`bar`].

cases.name: unknown_qualifier
cases.sql: SELECT x.foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo,2 AS bar) q
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `x`.`foo` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`q`.`foo`, `q`.`bar`].

cases.name: duplicate_output
cases.sql: SELECT Foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo) q CROSS JOIN (SELECT 2 AS bar) b
cases.message: [UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_SUGGESTION] A column, variable, or function parameter with name `Foo` cannot be resolved. Did you mean one of the following? [`q`.`foo`, `b`.`bar`].

cases.name: case_insensitive_success
cases.sql: SELECT Foo FROM (SELECT 1 AS foo) q
